import {mkdtempSync} from 'node:fs'
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
import {join} from 'node:path'

export function makeFolder(mkdtempSync: (prefix: string) => string, root: string): string {
  return mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), root))
}

export function makeOtherFolder(tmpdir: () => string): string {
  return mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'x-'))
}
